beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final question concerns which forms of knowledge and institutional memory must survive change.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The full argument offers conditional reasons for hope alongside limits, failures, and uncomfortable political possibilities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its value lies in connecting the assessment of danger with the quality of what follows.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to consider what another world should inherit, instead of demanding a promise about ours.
